title: Data for "Panic Buttons in the 'Smart Safe City': Analogue Artefacts as Part of Automated Surveillance Systems"
descriptions: This dataset contains details of newspaper articles from four newspaper outlets. These are collected from the database NexisUni. The dataset contains the article title, a link to the specific article, and the reason if an article was excluded from the analysis. There are 532 entries, of which 447 are included in the analysis.
